conventions.qe_cpu: QE CPU = rank-0 CPU seconds; cpu_wall_ratio_rank0 = CPU/WALL of rank 0
conventions.time_user: `time` user/sys in run.log = summed over all processes
conventions.per_q_wall: from cumulative PHONON lines (resolution 0.01 s < 1 h, 60 s above) and dyn<i> mtimes
conventions.disk: bytes = present now + deleted by pruning (manifests); a lower bound of bytes written
conventions.times: ISO 8601 local time of the run machine
